## Triage: first grade · `bug` · **`priority:p1` + `target:v18`** · `domain:ui` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-15T05:54Z

Read fresh. A `record:details` node with no `sections` renders one empty div. The spec declares that omitting `sections` falls back to the object's `highlightFields` (the retired `layout: 'auto'`). This was measured on a real `RecordDetailView`. The served `sys_approval_request_detail` page's Details tab is exactly that node, so every approver sees a blank Details tab: no request fields and no record-pointer card.
- **`priority:p1`** under the consumer-follow-up rule: "a declared block renders nothing" (`filing-gate.md` 〈定级判据〉). It is the follow-up of the 18 `layout` retirement.
- **`target:v18`:** listed on #12334.
- **Lane `domain:ui`** (`plugin-detail`). Build the declared fallback; ⛔ do not narrow at the consumer.
  - **`highlightFields`, the spec's words, governs** unless the spec seat says otherwise. That route also keeps `payload_json` and `node_config_json` from reaching a business approver as raw text, as the card warns.
- `finding` leaves on grading.

Claim: PM loop round 1 (priority:p1, taken first per the lane's P0/P1 read)
Session: `session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`
Account: `sunhaolin`

Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface: `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx` (the no-`sections` branch) and whatever it already reads the object definition and the `HighlightFieldsContext` registration through, the tests beside it, and one `.changeset/12433-*.md` (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` names no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: plugin-detail's `record:details` renderer, which draws an empty body when `sections` is omitted | `@objectstack/spec` declares the fallback ("omitting it falls back to the object's `highlightFields`", `ui/component.zod.ts`, the retired-`layout` entry), so the fix is the renderer honouring a declared behaviour | every approver who opens an approval request (objectstack `plugin-approvals`' served `sys_approval_request_detail` Details tab is a bare `record:details`), and any page an author or AI writes the same way
Thread-read: 6185500844
Serial constraints cleared: none. Read at objectui `main` after `6843f7599`. No open PR and no in-flight claim names `packages/plugin-detail/`. Seat 2's objectui#12413, #12422 and #12426 and seat 3's objectui#12423 touch `data-objectstack`, `plugin-list`, `AppContent.tsx` and the list toolbar, all disjoint.

- **Ruling carried:** triage `6185500844`: "Build the declared fallback; ⛔ do not narrow at the consumer. `highlightFields`, the spec's words, governs unless the spec seat says otherwise."
- **Accept-set reading:** no type, prop or export changes. The renderer draws what the spec already declares.
